name: Ford - National Parts Distribution Center, Livonia MI

fieldNotes.truckGate: Continuous chain-link perimeter fence rings the property along Middlebelt Rd (confirmed in 2025 Street View). Controlled driveway entrances through the fence into the dock yard.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clearly identifiable staffed booth at the entrances in Street View; small structures present but not confirmable as guard booths - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present, no confirmed booth - set true at low confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long bank of dock doors running the full east face of the ~1M sq ft building with trailers backed in; ~70 estimated -> 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large dedicated trailer-storage yard north of the property across the CSX rail line, plus trailers staged in the east yard; well over 50 -> 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lot (dozens of trailers) immediately north across the rail line.
fieldNotes.railServed: CSX rail line with sidings runs along the entire north edge of the property; rail cars present on the siding. A direct spur into the building is not clearly visible - set true at medium confidence.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Main ~1M sq ft DC plus a separate office/support building and trailer yard on the same campus.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Livonia industrial/commercial corridor on Middlebelt Rd between major roads -> Urban.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved yard and multiple driveway aprons leave room for an express lane.
